subject: Chain-of-trust artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG: KMS & HSM samples and rotation evidence
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mercuryfin.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@mercuryfin.com
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: chain-of-trust artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Mercury Financial's SIG intake we're requesting a compact "chain-of-trust" artifact package focused on KMS/HSM controls. To keep the scope tight, could you provide the following items by EOD 2027-05-27?

1) Operator shift logs (sample): one week of anonymized shift logs showing HSM operator actions, with timestamps and role IDs.
2) Key rotation schedule and a recent rotation event packet (what rotated, who approved, and exported snapshot of rotation logs).
3) HSM attestation letter (current year) and FIPS/PKCS#11 module details.
4) Evidence of in-transit wrapping (KEK wrapping call traces for TLS/TCP sessions) or a short narrative if wrapped by cloud KMS.

If any of these are sensitive, a stub or redacted sample is acceptable as long as timestamps/roles and the chain of approval are visible.

Can you confirm? If you need a short call, happy to do 30 min.

Best,
Olivia
Security Analyst, Mercury Financial

--
Olivia Park
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mercuryfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: chain-of-trust artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review

Thanks Olivia — we can get this to you. Marissa / Karthik, looping you both for collection and redaction guidance.

Plan:
- Marissa: prepare a one-week anonymized operator shift log sample and rotation packet; include the approval chain and a short manifest describing redactions.
- Karthik: pull the HSM attestation (current-year) and confirm wrapping traces; if we rely on cloud KMS for wrapping we'll include a short architecture note.

Target: initial package by 2027-05-27 EOD PST; if we need more time we'll communicate by 2027-05-25.

Olivia — can you confirm the preferred transfer method (secure SFTP link vs encrypted Google Drive link)? We'll attach a manifest and list of included files.

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Customer Security (Redwood Inference)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: chain-of-trust artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review

Sean — working on it; initial artifacts are attached and staged for transfer. Notes below and a short manifest in the package.

Attached (redacted samples):
- operator_shift_log_sample.csv (anonymized operator IDs, timestamps, action codes; no PII)
- kms_rotation_plan_v1.pdf (rotation cadence + last rotation event summary)
- hsm_attestation_20261201.pdf (vendor-signed attestation; redacted serials)

Quick notes:
- Operator logs: we've replaced internal usernames with role tags (OPERATOR_1, OPERATOR_2) and kept full timestamps to preserve timeline integrity.
- Rotation packet: includes the approval email thread (redacted), the rotation script checksum, and a snapshot of the rotation audit events.
- Wrapping: for tenant traffic we use cloud KMS envelope encryption; KMS call traces exported are in the manifest (sample logs) — for cross-DC transit wrapping there is an HSM-wrapped KEK; Karthik confirmed the external HSM wrap call appears in our audit events.

I staged the files for secure SFTP. Sean — please confirm and I will send the SFTP credentials to Olivia.

-Marissa
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: operator_shift_log_sample.csv (stub), kms_rotation_plan_v1.pdf (stub), hsm_attestation_20261201.pdf (stub)
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mercuryfin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, security@mercuryfin.com
Date: 2027-05-28T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: chain-of-trust artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review

Thanks Marissa — received the package via SFTP and confirmed files open. Two quick clarifying Qs:

1) In operator_shift_log_sample.csv the action codes column (ACTION_CODE) references an internal ops taxonomy — can you include a 1-paragraph mapping for the codes in the manifest? We only need the stable meanings, not full playbooks.
2) For the rotation packet, can you confirm who signed off on the last rotation (role + email) and attach the PKCS#11 module version we use for the HSM (vendor module string)? We've got the attestation but the module string was redacted.

If you can drop those two items in the same SFTP folder it will wrap up our SIG review for the KMS/HSM section.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Olivia
Security Analyst
Mercury Financial
